a: Cyprian yali mukugu mu by'okwogera amanyiddwa ennyo mu Carthage, ekibuga eky'okubiri mu Bugwanjuba obw'Ekilattini, ng'ali wakati mu myaka gye, bwe yafuuka Omukristaayo — ow'empisa ez'omulembe, eyeetaagibwa ennyo, atambulira mu basajja abaafuganga essaza. Yali asigazza emyaka kumpi kkumi n'ebiri gyokka egy'obulamu, era mu gyo n'ateekamu okukyuka kw'omutima, obugagga bwe yagaba, obulabirizi bwe yali tayagala, obuyigganya obubiri, kawumpuli, n'okuttibwa kwe. Ye musumba omukulu asooka mu Kkanisa ey'ebugwanjuba gwe tukyasobola okusoma ebbaluwa ze.

Yali ayise emyaka amakumi ana bwe waaliwo omukadde w'ekkanisa erinnya lye Caecilianus eyatandika okumunyumiza ku Kristo, ne kimusaanyaawo; n'atwala erinnya ly'omukadde oyo okuba erirye era teyalekayo kukkiriza bbanja eryo. Yawandiika ennyonnyola yaakyo eri mukwano gwe Donatus, ng'ayogera mazima ku nsonga lwaki yali alowooza nti okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw'okubiri tekiyinzika — enjegere ze zaali embaga, ezaabu n'engoye enzijuvu, n'ebibiina by'abagoberezi — ng'alowooza nti ebibi bye byali bitundu bya bulambulambu ku ye.

Ekintu kye yali alowooza nti tekiyinza kubaawo ne kibaawo: "olw'omulimu gw'Omwoyo eyafuuwibwa okuva mu ggulu, okuzaalibwa okw'okubiri kwali kunzizizzaawo okuba omuntu omuggya ... ekyo ekyali kirowoozebwa nti tekiyinzika, okuba ekisoboka okutuukirizibwa." Yakikolerako amangu ago, ng'atunda ebibanja n'awa abaavu ensimbi ezaavaamu, era n'akwata obulamu obwangu ennyo obwewuunyisa ekibuga ekyali kimutunuulidde ng'alya embaga okumala emyaka amakumi abiri; mu myaka ebiri, ye ng'akyekaanya, Abakristaayo b'e Carthage ne bamulanga okuba omulabirizi waabwe.

q: Obuyigganya bwa Decius bwali ki, era yavunaanibwa ki?
a: Mu Janwali 250 kabaka Decius yalagira buli mutuuze okuwaayo ssaddaaka eri bakatonda n'okufuna ekiwandiiko ekikakasa ekyo — obukodyo obw'olubereberye, obw'enteekateeka, mu bwakabaka bwonna okuzikiriza ekkanisa. Mu Carthage Abakristaayo bangi ne bagwa mu kukkiriza, era Cyprian ne yeekweka, ng'afuga ekibiina kye ekyamenyeka ng'ayita mu bbaluwa okumala omwaka n'okusingawo. Yalumbibwa olw'ekyo mu kiseera ekyo era n'okuva olwo; okwewolereza kwe kwali nti ekibiina kyali kileekaanira erinnya lye, era nti okufa kwe mu kaseera ako kwandimazeewo ekkanisa mu Carthage mu kifo ky'okugizzaamu amaanyi.

Yagaana ebisubizo ebyangu byombi. Ng'awakanya ab'amateeka amakalubo abaagamba nti abaagwa tebayinza kuddamu kukkirizibwa, era n'abo abaabasonyiwanga mu ngeri ennyangu, yasalawo nti abaawaayo ssaddaaka baalina okwenenya okwennyini ne balyoka bazzibwaawo, nti abaagula ebiwandiiko bayisibwe n'ekisa ekisingako, era nti tewali n'omu ayinza kuzzibwaawo lwa kigambo ky'omujulizi omu yekka ng'ali ebweru w'empisa z'ekkanisa. Empaka ezo zaamusindiikiriza okuwandiika ekitabo kye ku bumu bw'ekkanisa.

q: Yali ategeeza ki ku Kkanisa nga nnyina?
a: Mu kitabo kye On the Unity of the Church mwe muva sentensi ye eyamanyibwa era eyawakanyizibwako ennyo: "Tayinza nate kuba na Katonda nga Kitaawe, oyo atalina Kkanisa nga nnyina." Teyagiwandiika ng'endowooza obuwandiisi, wabula ng'omulabirizi agezaako okukuuma nga kiri kimu ekkanisa eyali yeeryamu obukuusa wansi w'okunyigirizibwa, ng'akakasa nti Abakristaayo abeeyawuddeyawudde bokka na bokka tebayinza kuba batuufu mu maaso ga Katonda.

q: Kawumpuli ayitibwa erinnya lye yali ki?
a: Okuva mu 252 endwadde ey'olukonvuba yabuna obwakabaka bwonna okumala emyaka — abalambuzi b'ebyafaayo bakyagiyita Kawumpuli wa Cyprian. Abantu ne badduka amaka gaabwe era abaali bafa ne bateekebwa ku luguudo. Cyprian yakuŋŋaanya ekibiina, n'awakanya ng'asinziira ku Kubuulira okw'oku Lusozi nti omwana wa Katonda kimugwanira okukoppa Kitaawe atonnyesa enkuba ne ku bagwira, era n'ategeka obuyambi bw'ekibuga: abalwadde ne bajjanjabibwa n'abafu ne baziikibwa awatali kubuuza oba amaka Makristaayo oba Makaafiiri — abantu abaali baagala omusaayi gwe ne bajjanjabibwa abo be baali baagala okutta.

q: Ekitabo kye ku Ssaala ya Mukama kiri kitya?
a: Ke kannyonnyola ka Lulattini akasooka ku ssaala eyo, era kakyali ekkubo erisinga obwangu okuyingira mu birowoozo bye. Endowooza yaakwo ekwewuunyisa: tetwandimanyi n'akatono engeri y'okwogera ne Katonda singa Katonda teyatubuulira — "Oyo eyatukola okuba abalamu, era yatuyigiriza n'okusaba." Ng'ayita mu ssaala akatundu ku katundu, yeeyongera okulaba nti ya bungi: tetugamba nti Kitaawe "wange" wabula "waffe," kubanga essaala yaffe ya lujjudde era ya bonna, esabirwa abantu bonna, kubanga ffenna tuli omu.

Mu 257 kabaka Valerian yalumba obukulembeze bw'ekkanisa; Cyprian n'agaana okuwaayo ssaddaaka era n'awaŋŋangusibwa e Curubis, omudiyakoni we gy'awandiika nti yalagibwa mu kwolesebwa ekibonerezo ky'okufa kwe era n'aweebwa okulwawo okw'omwaka. Bwe yakomezebwawo e Carthage, yasalirwa omusango omukungu era n'asalibwa omutwe ku lunaku olw'ekkumi n'ennya mu Ssebutemba 258, ng'asiba amaaso ge yennyini era ng'agezaako okwanguyiza omutemi, omukono gwe bwe gwali gukankana nnyo nga tasobola na kukwata kitala — ye mulabirizi wa Carthage asooka okufa ng'omujulirwa.

Kye yaleka kijjuvu mu ngeri ey'enjawulo eri omuntu ow'omu kyasa eky'okusatu: ebbaluwa ezisukka mu kinaana, ebitabo ebimpi nga kkumi na bibiri, n'enkola ey'obusumba ekkanisa ey'Ekilattini gye yandikozesezza okumala emyaka lukumi. Naye sentensi ekyaleeta abasomi okudda gy'ali ye eyo gye yawandiika mu ntandikwa y'ekisa, nga byonna tebinnabaawo, ng'akyali muntu bukyanga wakati mu myaka gye eyewuunya nti Katonda yali amukyusizza — "ekyo ekyali kirowoozebwa nti tekiyinzika, okuba ekisoboka okutuukirizibwa."
